design.target: Price change divided by median training price, independently per CPU/GPU
design.selectionPolicy: One fixed candidate; no tuning or promotion based on these scores.
design.mergePolicy: Append five distinct regions; preserve public global AZ IDs separately from original account-specific AZ names. Never fill beyond the public source window. Reject conflicting events and retain original dataset unchanged.
design.hardwarePolicy: Reuse verified original AWS instance-type GPU/vCPU counts for the same named instance types; public prices establish history, not current regional offerings or capacity.
design.comparisonPolicy: Frozen saved incumbent on identical targets. Incumbent uses its existing persistence fallback on unsupported regional pools. No combined CPU/GPU dollar MAE; new-region coverage gains are separate from same-pool accuracy gains.

limitations: Fixed-recipe post-holdout development; original October periods were previously examined.
New-region September results compare against incumbent persistence fallback, not incumbent trained regional models.
No public October observations: new-region September and Stockholm October errors cannot be pooled as equivalent tests.
No observed capacity/interruption labels, calibrated intervals, scheduler savings or serving-model replacement.
New-region September scoring predates the existing recipe selection cutoff; this is a retrospective coverage diagnostic, not an operational replay or fresh prospective test.
